tools.name: create_case
tools.responsibility: Create an investigation case header. No evidence interpretation.

tools.name: ingest_evidence
tools.responsibility: Read a project-scoped file, compute SHA-256 and metadata, and register immutable evidence provenance. Content remains untrusted data.

tools.name: parse_events
tools.responsibility: Parse supported evidence into normalized events with provenance. No compromise or maliciousness judgment.

tools.name: query_events
tools.responsibility: Run bounded structured filters over normalized case events. No arbitrary SQL, regex, shell, or executable query language.

tools.name: extract_iocs
tools.responsibility: Extract and normalize syntactic observables from selected events while preserving evidence references. Never label an indicator malicious by extraction alone.

tools.name: build_timeline
tools.responsibility: Order bounded normalized events by timezone-aware timestamps while preserving provenance.

tools.name: attack_lookup
tools.responsibility: Query a pinned local MITRE ATT&CK STIX snapshot and return official metadata. Never infer automatically that a technique occurred.

tools.name: sigma_validate
tools.responsibility: Validate one Sigma rule deterministically with pinned pySigma.

tools.name: sigma_test
tools.responsibility: Test one Sigma rule against explicit normalized case events using a bounded fail-closed matcher.
